description: Defines the OnlineSessionState class, which manages the client-side state of an online multiplayer game session, including server communication, player turns, dice results, and heartbeat tracking.

classes.name: OnlineSessionState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-derived class that maintains and updates the state of an online game session based on server messages, including player identities, game state, and connection status.

methods.name: subscribedMatchId
methods.description: Getter for the currently subscribed match ID.

methods.name: serverState
methods.description: Getter for the latest server-authoritative match state.

methods.name: lastDiceValue
methods.description: Getter for the last dice value received from the server.

methods.name: activePlayerId
methods.description: Getter for the ID of the player whose turn it is, according to server.

methods.name: selfPlayerId
methods.description: Getter for the client's player ID, if available.

methods.name: lastHeartbeatAt
methods.description: Getter for the timestamp of the last heartbeat received from the server.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Indicates whether the real-time connection is active.

methods.name: circuitOpen
methods.description: Indicates whether the network circuit breaker is open.

methods.name: canRollDice
methods.description: Determines if the user is allowed to roll dice based on game state.

methods.name: canMakeMove
methods.description: Determines if the user can make a move based on game state.

methods.name: setCircuitOpen
methods.description: Updates the network circuit breaker status.

methods.name: applyWsEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket messages to update session state accordingly.
